description: Data for scripts/hooks/agents_guard_pretooluse.py, the Claude Code PreToolUse hook that enforces the AGENTS.md hard rails. Matching logic per rule family lives in the hook; every pattern, path, unit, host and tier lives here. A rule with action=log never denies, even in deny mode. Paths may start with ~ (expanded to the running user's home at load time).
mode_note: TRADEAI_AGENTS_GUARD_MODE (log|deny) overrides this field. Operator approval 2026-10-09: log-only for the first week, then deny after the log review in docs/ops/AGENTS_GUARD_HOOK.md.

grant_ledger.note: Read-only. The hook never consumes or writes a grant. Active = expires > now and uses != 0 (same rule as .cursor/hooks/guard_ledger.py ledger_list).

archive_expiry_exception.note: AGENTS.md §0 rule 6 (never delete) and §17 (deleting anything is operator-only). When ratified, deletes under these paths of archives past their declared expiry would be allowed. Stays OFF until the operator ratifies it; flipping it is an AGENTS.md amendment (§20), not a config tweak.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §0 rule 2, §22 (A4/A5)
rules.reason: No agent ever calls a live broker. Live broker hosts are reachable only by the deterministic execution path.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §0 rule 2, §22 (A5)
rules.reason: No agent ever calls place_order or POSTs to an order route; broker order authority (A5) belongs to the deterministic execution path only.
rules.inline_note: Inline code must both call an order function and import a broker module; a script that only edits source text containing place_order( is not an invocation.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §0 rule 2, §17 (live flags are operator-only, A4)
rules.reason: Setting a live-trading flag is A4 live activation, which only the operator holds.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §0 rule 2, §22 (A1/A2 only under an execution-engineering grant)
rules.reason: The broker execution file set is editable only under an active operator execution-engineering grant naming the files, purpose and expiry.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §0 rule 2, §2A, §17
rules.reason: No agent ever reads or writes a live broker credential.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §0 rule 6, §17 (deleting anything is operator-only)
rules.reason: Never delete; archive with a tripwire. Recursive rm is allowed only under the temp allowlist.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §0 rule 6, §17
rules.reason: find -delete / -exec rm outside the temp allowlist deletes files.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §0 rule 6
rules.reason: git clean -f deletes untracked work irrecoverably; use -n to look, archive what must go.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §0 rule 6, §9.4 (additive only)
rules.reason: shred / truncate destroy file contents outside the temp allowlist.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §0 rule 6, §9.4 (ids removed = 0), §17
rules.reason: DROP / TRUNCATE / DELETE without WHERE removes rows or objects; store writes are additive only.
rules.scope_note: Scanned: a DB client's argv and heredocs, and inline python/node code that executes SQL. Not scanned: heredocs written to files, commit messages, PR bodies.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §0 rule 6, §17
rules.reason: docker volume rm / prune and system prune delete persistent container data (n8n scheduler-of-record DB lives in a volume).

rules.section: AGENTS.md §0 rule 3 (never route around a permission denial), AI_WORK_POLICY.md
rules.reason: Never bypass a hook: --no-verify, an emptied core.hooksPath or a skipped secrets scan routes around the local gates.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §0 rule 3 (no alternate remote)
rules.reason: Pushes go to origin only; an alternate remote or a raw URL routes around branch protection and the push budget.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §0 rule 3 (no direct-to-main push), §0 rule 4
rules.reason: Never push (force or not) to main/master; changes reach main through a reviewed PR.
rules.scope_note: Both push rules apply when the cwd (or git -C dir) is inside one of these, or is unknown. Pushes from other repos (agent memory repo, DOF project, n8n lab) are out of scope.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §0 rule 3 (no API call substituting for a blocked CLI; no branch rename)
rules.reason: gh api calls that merge, update a branch, move a ref or rename a branch substitute for the CLI and branch protection.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §0 rule 3 (no branch rename to reset a budget)
rules.reason: Renaming a branch resets the push budget; push from the branch you have.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §22 (merge is not separately enforced; operator merges), operator rail 'never merge'
rules.reason: gh pr merge by an agent. LOG-ONLY even in deny mode until the operator decides whether agents may merge.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §2A (the contents of .env in any form never leave this box)
rules.reason: Printing a secret file puts its values in the transcript. Name the variable, never its content; read NAMES with grep -o '^[A-Z_]*='.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §2A, ENGINEERING_HARD_RULES.md (secrets live in Bitwarden)
rules.reason: Agents never create or edit credential files.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §2A
rules.reason: A bare env/printenv/set/export -p dumps the whole environment, which may carry loaded secrets. LOG-ONLY: the Claude Code environment normally carries none.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §9.3, §10, §17 (any production systemd change is operator-only)
rules.reason: Starting, stopping or restarting a production unit needs an active operator 'service' grant.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §9.3 (installing, editing or removing a scheduler entry is operator-only), §17
rules.reason: crontab -r / -e / replace needs an active operator 'cron' grant (crontab -l is fine).

rules.section: AGENTS.md §10, §22 (A3 needs an exact-SHA operator grant)
rules.reason: Deploy prepare / promote / rollback needs an active operator 'release-write' grant naming the PR or SHA.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §0 rule 3, §17 (the operator grants; an agent never widens its own scope)
rules.reason: An agent must not issue itself a grant or write the approval ledger. Ask with 'bin/guard request'.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §7A, §10, §20 (governed files change through a reviewed PR, never in the served release or persistent-state)
rules.reason: Governed files are edited in a worktree and land by PR; editing the served copy bypasses review and the release manifest.

rules.section: AGENTS.md §0 rule 3 (never route around a permission denial)
rules.reason: Editing Claude Code settings can uninstall or weaken this hook; settings changes are the operator's.
